title: Add Z21 LAN protocol dissector
description:
Z21 LAN protocol is used for digital control of model railways. It is used between the handheld controllers (or mobile devices or workstations with appropriate software) and the command center (that actually commands the digitally-controlled trains or other devices).

Protocol specification can be downloaded in https://www.z21.eu/en/downloads/manuals.

Sample capture: [Z21-test.pcapng](/uploads/fbdca65f6243623198a8c16b86a27f6e/Z21-test.pcapng)
